label: human-31
people: [gecko]thebluegecko (34), played Cortex; [gecko]u6bkep (19), played Armada. The header records both as Armada; the factions come from the units seen and the transcripts ('thebluegecko plays Cortex ... u6bkep plays Armada', commander 3:20). computer_whisperer hosted as a spectator and said nothing.
our_side: Three Cortex seats on the east strip under a side commander: t2 north at G1 (seat 0, record-0), t4 middle at G4 (seat 2, record-2), t3 south at H8 (seat 1, record-1). Each seat was an Opus 5.5 medium player with Jev jev-latest (1.13.0) hands. The commander was Opus 5.5 at high effort. Realtime, Claude Code 2.1.296.
build: efa6d21 (banner: 'Within Reason efa6d21 | player (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium, 2.1.296 (Claude Code)) | hands: Jev jev-latest'; the last commit before the game, 2026-10-10)
summary: u6bkep opened with a Rover pack in our south (1:58), and thebluegecko walked his commander forward with Guards and Pounders to C4, then into our half at E4 and E2. Our three seats beat the Rovers (54 killed by 4:50) but held only 11 extractors between them at 4:50, and t2 stayed capped at 9 from 8:00 under his towers. From 7:00 to 14:00 the side's summed army stood 1.4-6.3x what we saw of theirs, but it fought in our own half, seat by seat. The 9:20 strike at his base at B5 went with 7 Brutes, met u6bkep's Blitz mass at E6 and turned back, and at 10:50 the commander chose 'We stay on tier 1 for now', as the brief of that build advised. thebluegecko then switched to bombers (11:15) and tier 2 (Quaker 13:19, Tigers 13:21). The south body broke u6bkep's army at E6 by 14:41, but the Tiger block ate it (15:32-15:52), took t4's home and its unfinished advanced plant (16:54-17:30), then took t2 (19:33).

root.what: The last cheap moment, spent: the base was found, his tier 2 was not yet seen, and the side's army was about 3.7-5.9x what we saw of his. The commander named it ('Now is the moment, before his tier 2 comes') but sent only t4's 7 Brutes; t2 and t3 held at home. They turned back at E6 (10:46), and at 10:50 the side stayed tier 1. Reader's reading; the commander's own 18:20 note agrees. The window from 3:00 had already been spent at home.
root.evidence: minutes.py seat 0: '9 | 1857/1430 ... E2 (1%)', '10 | 2176/910 ... E3 (1%)' (seats 1, 2: 0%); commander 9:20: 'Now is the moment, before his tier 2 comes'; 10:50: 'We stay on tier 1 for now.'

our_mistakes.what: Slow opening in all three seats: three solars before the plant, the plant late, few units by 4:00, and 11 extractors between three seats at 4:50. A stronger side starts the plant at ~1:00 on two solars and gets its first constructors out to the spots before raiders arrive.
our_mistakes.evidence: pro_baseline (all starts): plant started 1:09 / 1:15 / 1:16 vs pool p75 1:03; 'solars before the plant 3' (pool 2); 'factory units by 4:00 12 / 10 / 12' vs p25 16

our_mistakes.what: The first window went to the turrets. t3 kept its army at home against Rovers it could not catch, while t2's and t4's Incisors went at the C4 and D1 turrets in groups of 3 and died. t4's group_B was walked to its hold point under the C4 Light Laser Tower (corllt) and Pounder (corlevlr) and hit every second until 3 died. A stronger side sends one body round the nest to his extractors, or leaves a Guard to kill the Rovers.

their_play: thebluegecko (Cortex, 34): commander forward from the start. It was laying extractors with a Guard at C4 by 2:24-3:20, at E4 by 4:50 and at E2 by 13:12, in our half. Behind it came a Pounder block and Guards and Twin Guards at C1, C4, E2 and E3, which held t2 at 9 extractors and dragged its groups under the turrets. His base at B5 (seen 8:15-8:26) had a vehicle plant, 3 construction turrets, 17 solars and 2 advanced solars. He built an unseen air plant: Whirlwind bombers from 11:15 took about 20 solars. Tier-2 vehicles followed: Quaker 13:19, Tiger 13:21, then 7 Tigers by 15:00, 11 by 17:00 and 25 by 19:00, with mohos and an advanced constructor at D5 (17:13-17:20). The Tiger block rolled up the south body, then t4, then t2. u6bkep (Armada, 19): a Rover pack in t3's home from about 1:58, then Blitzes in ones and twos at constructors, and a 13-15 Blitz mass with Beamers, Stouts and Janus at D6-E7, which was broken at E6 by 14:41. His base was never seen.

The loss rests partly on this since-fixed brief text.

bears_on.note: The side's summed army was 2.8-5.9x his seen army at 7:00-10:00 with 0-2% in his half. It went bad when his bombers (11:15) and Tigers (13:21) came.
Commander 7:50: 'each seat met a larger body alone'. The 9:20 strike was one seat's 7 Brutes, and the 16:50 one body at t4_line never gathered.
Energy was full on every seat for minutes ('+565 E surplus' 16:50), yet no seat started tier 2 until 14:32, metal-bound at 25/s.
Tier-1 Pounders, Brutes and Lashers against Tigers: 16 Pounders lost in t4's home at 16:54-17:59 for 3 Tigers.
thebluegecko's Twin Guard and Guard nest at E2-E3 dragged t2's group in (10:12, 10:33). His bombers came at 11:15, and two seats had no anti-air although the commander asked at 0:20.
'air switch to bomb solar is strong in the tank phase': 8-17 Whirlwinds took about 20 solars at 11:15-12:20.
11 extractors across three seats at 4:50 ('one experienced player holds 9 alone'). His towers held spots in our half, and t2 stayed at 9 from 8:00.
The first Rascals and Incisors crossed at 2:05-4:05, then turned back or died at the C4 and D1 turrets, 1,436-2,921 short of his start.
u6bkep's Rover pack burned 4 of t3's extractors at 1:58-3:17, uncatchable by Incisors. Then 54 Rovers died by 4:50 to the commander and Guards.
His commander stood forward at C4, E4 and E2 for minutes. The one try (t2, 13:12) went in late, alone, into Twin Guards and Quakers, and lost 7 units.
On Comet the commander asked for converters at 16:50 with the energy full; the lesson says the map needs none and the spare energy goes into storage or bombers.
4,100 metal of wrecks at E6 and D6 (14:54). bot.log at 20:00: '13458 metal (7338 safe to work), 0 at work'.

tools: run/minutes.py (seat 0; seats 1 and 2 via symlinked scratch dirs)
lens.existing_review: none (no review.md; the match directory holds the 2026-10-16 impedance-review.md and the 2026-10-17 unfinished-review.md, read and built on)
lens.caveats: Several gaps limit the reading. There is no truth file, so his numbers are what we saw (floors), and when he started his advanced and air plants is unknown. The record-reading tools take record-0 only, so seats 1 and 2 were read through scratch dirs with each record linked as record-0. Per-seat 1.5x windows compare one seat with his whole seen army, so the side's sums were computed by hand. pro_baseline is the 1v1 pool; a team seat holds about a third of our half, and its pressure rows read '-' for every seat. raid_ledger's 'answered 0' for seats 1 and 2 may be a tool artifact. impedance_sweep was not rerun; its 2026-10-16 review was read instead. There is no ledger row and no review.md. No person spoke except 'gg wp', so every 'because' here is the reader's reading or the commander's own.

open_questions: When did thebluegecko start his advanced vehicle plant and air plant? Neither was ever seen (coracv first seen 17:20). The replay or a truth file would date his tier 2 against our 10:50 choice.
How many extractors did the two people hold at 10:00 against our 31? This decides whether the side was behind on economy from about 5:00 or only on tech.
Would one body of all three seats at B5 at 9:20 have broken thebluegecko before his tier 2? This is unmeasured; the side's seen-army lead was 3.7-5.9x.
Did the 3:20 direction 'They do not go at his commander or his Guards at C4' give up the chance to deny his forward base, which later capped t2 at 9 extractors?
Our player asked at 18:39 what the people would have done at about 13:00. No answer is in the chat; did either person answer outside the game?
